name: qwen3-coder-next-q4km
about: Alibaba Qwen3-Coder-Next, mixture of experts (80B, about 3B active; hybrid linear and full attention), Q4_K_M GGUF as published by Qwen, served with llama.cpp. Apache-2.0. About 48 GB, so one A100. Instruct only, no thinking. llama.cpp cannot force a named tool, so the agent's last 'submit now' request runs with tool_choice auto.
